body:
Triage (maintainer-directed batch, 2026-08-07): routed `domain:identity` — `member_default`'s `*` wildcard C/R/E grant is defined in plugin-security's default permission sets, and the erasing union-merge lives in its PermissionEvaluator. `bug` + `target:v17` retained. Anchored by code read; triage seat may veto.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**转决策箱**(identity 车道 PM,`session_01JwwiU9bjhwy2SWj13ho8uv`,第 14 轮;加 `needs-user-decision`,建议与 **#5492 同席裁决** —— 两单语义耦合,#5492 comment 5217346436 有连带说明)。

**具体问题**:`member_default` 的 `*` 通配符 C/R/E 授权 union 进每个 org member,app 显式 allow 门在三轴上被抹掉(21 条 create 拒绝探针全部 201;显式全 false 的 profile 照样建单);且今天**显式 deny 不胜 union**,app 无受支持的退路。

**可选方案(三族,均越出 PM 授权面 —— 改的都是每个部署的默认安全姿态或权限求值公开语义)**:
- **A. 收窄/摘除种子里的通配符**(member_default 只留平台自身必需面)—— 最直接,但改变全部存量部署的开箱行为,需要迁移叙事;
- **B. 让显式 deny 胜过 union**(permission 求值加优先级语义)—— 保留通配符便利,但这是权限求值契约变更,半径含 #5492 的 modifyAllRecords 同一 union 通道(dev 实测确认耦合);
- **C. 受支持的 opt-out**(app 可声明豁免 member_default 的 union)—— 新契约面,防 AI 错误轴上最弱(默认仍 default-open)。

**三轴粗评**:实际业务(HotCRM 188 探针,5 profile 全部被抹平 —— 真实拉动,非投机);长期(declared ≠ enforced 落在安全层自身,与 ADR-0049 直接冲突;#2753 先例说明 member_default 的边界曾被专门收束过);防 AI 错误(A/B 都让「显式声明生效」结构性成立;C 最弱)。倾向 **A 或 B**,但两者的迁移代价与 #5492 的裁决方向强相关,故不单独预裁,提请同席定夺。

**Maintainer ruling — 2026-08-07.** The maintainer reviewed the PM's three-axis analysis of the decision inbox and accepted the recommendations (「你帮我综合评估，我接受你的建议」). Recorded by the PM session; `needs-user-decision` comes off with this comment.

**Decision: remove the `*` wildcard object grant from `member_default` on all three live axes (create / read / edit; delete is already false).** The platform baseline narrows to explicit-allow: object access comes from OWDs plus profile / permission-set declarations only. Deny-precedence merge semantics were considered and rejected — changing union-merge globally is a larger contract change than deleting the one grant that poisons it.

Rationale (three axes): measured erasure of app-declared explicit-allow (21/21 create-denial probes returned 201; real unauthorized reads on `public_read`); declared ≠ enforced inside the security layer itself; a hidden most-permissive union is unlearnable for AI-authored app metadata — CI stays green while the runtime posture is default-open.

Constraints for the implementing lane:
- **MUST land in the same batch as #5492** — once the wildcard is gone, cross-owner writes depend entirely on the declared wideners #5492 turns on. Landing either card alone strands managers or keeps the hole.
- Ship with a migration note: deployments relying on the implicit wildcard lose that access — that is the intended behavior change and belongs in the changeset text.
- Existing security suites that (correctly) assert denial must stay verbatim; add positive probes per axis showing profile grants still work.

**ACCEPT** — PR #6684 (paired with #5492; identity seat, round 1 review). Full review trail on #5492 (comment posted in the same stroke); the #5491 half, verified specifically:

- The `'*'` grant is **removed from `member_default`** (all three live axes; delete was already profile-driven) — the baseline narrows to explicit-allow per the ruling; deny-precedence was NOT implemented (ruling rejected it; sets stay additive per ADR-0090).
- `sys_user_preference` self-service converted implicit→**explicit** entry (effective member access byte-identical); identity-table reads kept, writes still denied; `owner_only_*` RLS policies and anchor-safety untouched; admin sets keep their deliberate wildcards.
- **25-case `member-default-explicit-allow.test.ts`** pins the new posture on the real merge path, including the exact "granted by [member_default]" union this issue measured — an explicit all-false profile now stays denied after the merge.
- **Reverse verification**: wildcard restored → exactly those 9 pins red, nothing else.
- **Migration narrative ships as a breaking changeset** naming the intended behavior change, the two supported re-declaration paths, and `security/explain` as the pre-upgrade audit tool — per the ruling's constraint.
- Fixture blast radius triaged case-by-case (matrix roles re-declare the removed grant byte-for-byte so every `EXPECTED_MATRIX` cell is unchanged; dogfood boots the showcase's own default profile the way the CLI does; #3003's non-admin property preserved with named grants, not a wildcard).
